subject: Fractional Payment Ordinance and Fundraising Strategies
overview: The board established officer responsibilities and quarterly financial reporting protocols to manage increasing trust revenue. Members also reviewed technical edits to the fractional payment ordinance and explored diverse revenue streams including donations, tax bill check-offs, and linkage fees.

items.title: Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the December 10, 2025, meeting.

items.title: Roles and Responsibilities
items.summary: Defined the responsibilities for trust officers, including a new requirement for the treasurer and staff to provide quarterly financial reports, balance sheets, and interest tracking.

items.title: Fractional Payment Ordinance
items.summary: Discussed technical edits to the fractional payment ordinance intended to ensure fee calculations remain current relative to building permit applications. The board agreed to let staff refine the language with legal counsel and provide a final draft for review via email.

items.title: Fundraising and Donations
items.summary: Explored strategies to increase revenue through public donation fact sheets, estate bequests, and adding a donation check-box to city tax bills. Staff provided updates on an open linkage fee study RFP and a $500,000 commitment from Tufts University contingent on dormitory occupancy.
